criteria.text: Given the Command Center, when it is opened, then every tab is reachable and every card drills down one level.
Given sample mode, when any tab is shown, then the sample data is visibly labelled as sample.
Given the data files, when any tab renders, then its content comes from .colaberry/plan.json and .colaberry/progress.json read at runtime rather than from hard-coded values.
Given .colaberry/manifest.json, when any tab is shown, then it displays how old the data is and warns when that age exceeds a week.
Trust — no tab shows a number, a connection or a result the project has not actually produced.

REQ-006.note: No audit log exists yet — nothing has been built.

REQ-011.note: No PHI handling code exists yet.

REQ-014.note: No AI action pathway exists yet — nothing to gate.

doneMeans.text: Given the Command Center, when it is opened, then every tab is reachable and every card drills down one level.
doneMeans.note: All 9 tabs built. Every card on every tab's list view now has an href to a detail page — fixed an earlier gap where several Overview cards (Requirements, Stories, Demo day, Outcomes preview, Guardrails summary) were static instead of links.

doneMeans.text: Given sample mode, when any tab is shown, then the sample data is visibly labelled as sample.
doneMeans.note: Sample banner + SAMPLE badge shown wherever fabricated data renders (Outcomes only — the one place sample data legitimately applies).

doneMeans.text: Given the data files, when any tab renders, then its content comes from .colaberry/plan.json and .colaberry/progress.json read at runtime rather than from hard-coded values.
doneMeans.note: index.html fetches both files at runtime via relative paths. A fallback snapshot exists in the JS for contexts where fetch can't reach sibling files (e.g. a single-file preview) — when served normally, fetched data overwrites it.

doneMeans.text: Given .colaberry/manifest.json, when any tab is shown, then it displays how old the data is and warns when that age exceeds a week.
doneMeans.note: Top bar shows a data-age pill on every tab, sourced from manifest.generatedAt and manifest.staleAfterDays.

doneMeans.text: Trust — no tab shows a number, a connection, or a result the project has not actually produced.
doneMeans.note: Systems and guardrail status are always real (never toggled by sample mode). Outcomes shows "Not measured yet" in real mode. Story status is honestly not-started everywhere.

decisions.text: No brand colors were supplied for MeshMedic, so the Command Center uses a neutral palette defined in one CSS token block for a later one-line swap.
Systems and guardrail statuses are treated as always-real, never toggled by sample mode — connection state and code-enforcement state are facts, not something safe to fabricate.
REQ-011 (PHI protection) has no story in the current plan that scopes its implementation directly — flagged as an open gap rather than force-mapped to an unrelated story.
